title: Shared definitions of the answers of the staff tools (decision 0107)

days.description: The four days of a run, as the staff timed it: loading begins on load, the force sails on sail, it is due at the destination on arrive, and its ships are free (back at the source and refuelled) on free.

reading.description: One reading of the projection: the stock at the start of the day, the planned use of that day and the figure in days of supply (null where the use is 0).

reason.description: The five parts of a staff decision: what it serves, the evidence it rests on, what binds it, the calculation and what would change it.

serves.description: What the decision serves: the intent, the plan and the plan's amendment (left out where none), and the intent's statement: the intent in words as the commander set it and as it stood when the reason was made (left out where a reason has none). And chain: the intents above it, nearest first.

level.description: The level that decided (decision 0120, 2): the addressee of the intent served, "area", {"base": n} (n the base's number) or {"task_force": n} (n the side's number of the task force; decisions 0124 and 0125) or {"air_group": n} (n the side's number of the air group, for a setting of one group's). Left out where a reason has none.

chain.description: The intents above the one served, nearest first, each as it stood when the reason was made; the last is one you stated. Left out where the intent is a root (decision 0117, 10).

answer_of.description: Decision 0214: the number of the task force whose leave to pursue the decision rests on. Left out where none.

cautions.description: Decision 0217: what the commander should weigh before he approves, each with the unit or place it is of. Left out where there are none.

limits.description: Decision 0222, rule 5: the limits the reason speaks of, each with its kind and the intent it is set on (or, for a reserve, the base). Left out where there are none.

reason_limit.description: One limit a reason speaks of (decision 0222, rule 5): its kind, and the intent it is set on, which may be above the one the reason serves, or the base of a reserve.

caution.description: One caution of a reason (decision 0217): its kind, the unit it is of as a handle, the place it is of as a hex (each left out where there is none) and its words.

not_yet_available.description: The units of the limit whose day has not come, each with the day the side may use it from (decision 0140, 5). Left out when none.

land_units.description: The side's numbers of the land units the staff may order (decision 0141).

submarines.description: The side's numbers of the boats a patrol intent may use (decision 0218, stage 3). Left out when none.

none_of.description: Decision 0222, the architect's ruling A: the kinds of which the staff may use nothing. Left out when none.

in_place.description: Decision 0222, the architect's ruling I: the task forces named work from where they lie. Left out when false.

risk.description: The risk level set on this intent itself; null where none is set (limits_read_up gives what it is read as).

not_before.description: Decision 0159, 9: the day before which the staff does not release the plan, set on this intent itself; null where none is set.

wait_for.description: Decision 0159, 9: the task force or land unit, in the side's numbers, the staff waits for before it releases the plan, set on this intent itself; null where none is set.

after.description: Decision 0159, 9: the intent whose place must be the side's before the staff releases the plan, set on this intent itself; null where none is set.

knowledge.description: Decision 0159, 12: how much must be known before the landing goes, set on this intent itself; null where none is set (the risk then decides).

targets.description: Decision 0190: the kinds of ship the intent's bombers strike, in order, and whether the deny's waters come first, set on this intent itself. Left out where none is set.

kinds.description: One to six kinds of ship, each once, most wanted first, as the order set_target_priority names them.

waters_first.description: True only on a deny or an intent beneath one: the deny's waters are struck first.

knowledge.description: A knowledge setting (decision 0159, 12): none (any count or none), count (seen from the air or by men in contact, of any day) or recent_count (such a count no more than within_days days old on the morning it goes).

need_to_know.description: Decision 0159, 13: what must be known of the enemy at a take's place before its landing goes, as the staff works it this morning, for a take whose plan is preparing. Worked when asked and stored nowhere; nothing of the enemy but your own estimate is in it.

intent.description: The take_place whose plan it is.

from.description: The intent the knowledge limit is set on; null where the risk sets what is asked (press none, balanced a count, preserve a recent count of 3 days).

held.description: Your estimate of the enemy's men at the place; null where you hold none.

age_days.description: The morning's day less the count's day.

could_be.description: What the count could be in truth, from its grade's error range in the ground figures: lowest is the count over the high end cut to a whole man, highest the count over the low end raised to a whole man (null where the low end is 0). Null for a count that was told, or where the figures give no range for its grade.

looking.description: The air group on reconnaissance of the place after this morning's orders, in your numbers, and the day it was set to it (null where no order of yours set it); null where none is looking.

moved_to_look.description: Decision 0159, 14: the carrier force, in your numbers, the staff moves or has moved to a hex from which a group aboard can look at the place, while the need is not met; null where none is.

awaited.description: What a wait_for names (decision 0159, 9): one of task_force and land_unit, in the side's numbers.

base.description: The side's own base the intent names; null for neutralise and deny.

target.description: The enemy base a neutralise, a raid or a bombard is aimed at (decisions 0120 and 0146); null for the other kinds.

hex.description: The centre of the waters of a deny intent as [q, r] (decision 0123), the station of a stand_at or operate_carriers intent, the landing hex of a ready_landing intent or the place of a take_place intent; null for the other kinds.

distance.description: The distance in hexes of the waters of a deny intent (decision 0123); null for the other kinds.

task_force.description: The side's number of the task force a stand_at, operate_carriers, ready_landing or bombard intent names (decisions 0124, 0125, 0141 and 0146); null for the other kinds (a take_place has none).

by_day.description: The morning of the day a ready_landing or take_place intent is to be ready by or to have taken the place by (decisions 0141 and 0142); null for the other kinds and for one with no date.

wants.description: What a build_up intent wants, in order (decision 0141); null for the other kinds.

island.description: The number of the island a control_island intent names (decision 0151); null for the other kinds.

defences.description: The points of defences a build_up intent wants, from 1 to 100, when defences is among its wants (decision 0141); null otherwise.

need_to_know.description: Decision 0159, 13: for a take_place whose plan is preparing this morning, what must be known before it goes; null for any other plan (a released plan is no longer asked).

command_body.description: A command as the interface writes it: its kind and the keys that kind has (see set_intent, form_intent (which may form keep_supplied under a hold, with floor_days, which may be 0, and an optional interval_days, decision 0144), set_limit, set_leave, set_pursuit, answer_pursuit, hold, release, approve, cancel_plan, set_interrupt and acknowledge), ships and task forces in your numbers.

staff_notice_pursuit.description: Decision 0214: for the three notices of a pursuit, the force (your number), the intent it would leave (or leaves) and the find; left out for every other notice.

find.description: Left out for a notice that a pursuit is ended.

hours.description: The hours to the hex by the engine's forecast, a decimal string; null where it has none.

asking.description: Decision 0214, rule 7: a force's asking leave to pursue a find, as the stop in the evening gives it: what the staff would hand in for the coming day and would fire the standing interrupt. Hexes are {q, r}.

intent.description: The order the force would leave: it is not withdrawn or changed.

contact.description: The contact's number, which answer_pursuit takes.

to.description: The hex the force would close to.

hours.description: The hours to it by the engine's forecast, as the game's decimal text; null where it has none.

items.description: A staff command: the command's own keys, and its reason.

notices.description: Notices the staff hands in beside its orders: that a plan cannot meet its intent, waits for a leave, or has had a run end. Each rests on one of the commands or decisions to give no order above, by its place in the list. Left out when there is none.

displacement.description: A commitment to another plan that keeps an intent from a run or cuts its load: ships, or tons at the source still to be loaded, with the plan, the run and the days.

hold_target.description: What a hold keeps from the staff, in your numbers: a ship, a task force, one setting of an air group, a whole air group, or a land unit (decision 0141).

firing.description: One interrupt that fired on a morning, in your numbers: a set one (interrupt, base, below_days, figure) or a standing one (standing with plan or ship). why is the numbers why takes for the reasons the notices it rests on were handed in with (empty for a set interrupt and for a ship lost); event is the firing's own number, which explain takes.

task_force.description: Decision 0214: with standing asks_leave_to_pursue, your task force's number.

interrupts.description: The interrupts of your command: every numbered interrupt you set, every standing record that has fired, and the standing kinds you have switched off. Those fired and not acknowledged come first.

needs_acknowledgement.description: true if it has fired and the last firing is not acknowledged.
true if it has fired and the last firing is not acknowledged.

text.description: One line for each interrupt, record and switched-off kind, those fired and not acknowledged first.

limits_read_up.description: An intent's limits as the staff reads them, up the tree, where every limit on the chain binds: the least bold risk, the hexes in every area, the groups in every forces limit (`air_groups_binding`); `forces` is the nearest forces limit, and each `_from` names the intent it is read from, and for forces and risk what holds where none is set (decision 0117, 7 and 8).

not_yet_available.description: The units of the limit whose day has not come, each with the day the side may use it from (decision 0140, 5). Left out when none.

land_units.description: The side's numbers of the land units the staff may order (decision 0141).

submarines.description: The side's numbers of the boats a patrol intent may use (decision 0218, stage 3). Left out when none.

none_of.description: Decision 0222, the architect's ruling A: the kinds of which the staff may use nothing. Left out when none.

in_place.description: Decision 0222, the architect's ruling I: the task forces named work from where they lie. Left out when false.

air_groups_binding.description: The air groups named in every forces limit on the chain, which are all the staff may use (the narrowest binds); null where no forces limit is set on the chain.

submarines_binding.description: The boats named in every forces limit on the chain that names any, which are all a patrol intent may use (decision 0218, stage 3). Left out where no limit on the chain names a boat.

land_units_binding.description: The land units named in every forces limit on the chain, which are all the staff may order (decision 0141); null where no forces limit is set on the chain.

not_before.description: Decision 0159, 9: the latest not_before day on the intent and above it; null where none is set. Only a take_place's release reads it.

not_before_from.description: The intent that latest day is set on; null where none is set.

wait_for.description: Decision 0159, 9: every wait_for on the intent and above it, nearest first, each with the intent it is set on (from). Each binds.

after.description: Decision 0159, 9: every after on the intent and above it, nearest first: the intent whose place must be the side's, and the intent the limit is set on (from). Each binds.

knowledge.description: Decision 0159, 12: the knowledge limit nearest on the intent and above it; null where none is set and the risk decides how much must be known.

knowledge_from.description: The intent that knowledge limit is set on; null where none is set.

targets.description: Decision 0190: the targets limit nearest on the intent and above it. Left out where none is set.

kinds.description: One to six kinds of ship, each once, most wanted first, as the order set_target_priority names them.

waters_first.description: True only on a deny or an intent beneath one: the deny's waters are struck first.

targets_from.description: Decision 0190: the intent that targets limit is set on. Left out where none is set.

neutralise_measure.description: The measure of a neutralise intent (decision 0120, 8): the days it has been in force, the raids the side's bomber groups flew on the target in them (each pulse in which one of them launched at the target is one raid), the aircraft the side's people claim to have destroyed on the ground at the target from the air (a claim, as the briefing's claims are, never below the truth), the air raids on the side's own bases in those days, and the days of them on which no base of the side was raided from the air; and the words.

deny_measure.description: The measure of a deny intent (decision 0123, 4): the days it has been in force, the distinct contacts the side held in the waters at the end of a day in them, the strikes launched in them from the bases given the task of striking ships under it, the ships sunk and the hits the side's people claim from the air in the waters (claims, never below the truth and never corrected), and the days of them that ended with no contact held in the waters, with its words.

island_measure.description: The measure of a control_island intent (decision 0151, 10 and 11): the days it has been in force, the days of them on which every named place was the side's at the end of the day with its supply above its reserve and at least its floor of days of supply, each place as the side stands in it today, and the words.

places.description: The island's named places in its order.

base.description: The number of the base the island names at the place; null for a bare coast hex.

ours.description: Whether the side holds a base in the hex today.

hold_measure.description: The measure of a hold intent (decision 0117, 14): the days it has been in force and the days of them the base was the side's at the end of the day with its airfield open, the air raids on the base in those days and how many a patrol of the side's fought, the base's days of supply today (null where no figure), and the words.
